pass_condition:
For EVERY seed in {0,1,2}:
  (AUROC(tau=0.00) - AUROC(tau=0.85)) <= 0.05
  AND AUROC(tau=0.85) >= 0.70
status_rule: PASS if the pass_condition holds. PARTIAL if mean_over_seeds(auroc_gap) <= 0.05 and mean(AUROC_0.85) >= 0.70 but at least one seed fails the every-seed rule. FAIL otherwise.
